reason: The README clearly describes a file-drop plugin that accepts non-image files, obtains local paths or uploads file contents, and places them into the agent workspace for reading.

summaries.zh: 通过拖拽或文件选择器将 PDF、Word、Excel、ZIP 和文本等非图片文件加入输入框，并在支持时获取本地路径或保存到会话工作区。
summaries.en: Accepts non-image files such as PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, ZIP archives, and text through drag-and-drop or a file picker, using local paths when available or saving uploads to the session workspace.

capabilities: Accepts files through drag-and-drop and a system file picker
Reads local file paths when supported by the desktop shell
Uploads fallback files to the session workspace
Writes uploaded file contents into the workspace
